papers.title: Thermal Drift Modeling in Field Micro-Spectrometers
papers.key_finding: Static thermal calibration keeps indoor drift at 2.8% over 4 hours.
papers.limitation: Fails to bound drift during rapid outdoor humidity swings above 75% RH.

papers.title: Active Peltier Stabilization for Portable Optical Probes
papers.venue: IEEE Transactions on Instrumentation and Measurement
papers.key_finding: Active Peltier control holds outdoor error within 1.2% across 15-40 C.
papers.limitation: Draws 6.5 W continuous power, restricting battery-powered field endurance.
